found.quote: Passing off someone – or something’s – work as your own for an assessment is academic misconduct. This could be failing to cite a source you have used in a piece of assessed work, getting someone or something else (such as an AI agent) to complete your work for you, claiming authorship of machine-generated content or presenting machine-translated work as your own.
